preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of string A is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The length of string B is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Yes' or 'No', indicating whether it is possible to choose some non-empty strings s1 and s2 such that s1 is a substring of A, s2 is a substring of B, and s1 + s2 is a palindromic string.
